diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period between completed bodies. The candidate used `period: 0` (one-shot) and included a trailing `delay(3 MIN)`, causing the first action to fire at t=0 and the next at t=180000, whereas the IR requires the first body to start at t=0 and the next at t=180000. The candidate missed the first scheduled action at t=180000 because it terminated after the initial run.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed `period` from 0 to 180000 to enable repetition. Removed the trailing `delay(3 MIN)` which was incorrectly emulating the cycle period. The script now repeats the body (call, delay, call) every 3 minutes as required by the IR.
